Saw.snap: two men chained in a filthy bathroom learn to appreciate life, the very hard way.

Dune.snap: a space messiah reluctantly signs up for his desert-and-sandworm destiny.

Tenet.snap: spies fight a war backwards through time; do not, under any circumstance, try to understand it.

Arrival.snap: a linguist learns an alien language and it quietly reorganizes her sense of time.

Bugonia.snap: two guys are certain the CEO they kidnapped is an alien, and will not be talked out of it.

Contact.snap: a scientist finally gets the alien phone call, then has to prove it to a world that won't listen.

Conclave.snap: cardinals lock themselves in a room to pick a pope and it turns into a political knife fight.

Deep Impact.snap: a comet is coming, so here is everyone who will be sad about it, in an orderly fashion.

Oppenheimer.snap: the man who built the bomb spends three hours realizing what he did.

The Martian.snap: an astronaut left for dead on Mars decides to science his way home.

Interstellar.snap: a farmer-astronaut punches through a wormhole because love is somehow the fifth dimension.

Don't Look Up.snap: two scientists discover a planet-killing comet and nobody can be bothered to care.

The Substance.snap: a fading star takes a shortcut to a younger self, and the body keeps the receipts.

Dune: Part Two.snap: the messiah stops being reluctant, and that is exactly the problem.

Project Hail Mary.snap: a science teacher wakes up alone in deep space and has to save the sun with chemistry.

Everything Everywhere All at Once.snap: a laundromat audit spirals into a multiverse held together by hot dogs and kindness.
